items.title: Malik Nabers: Expected to play Sunday
items.text:
Head coach John Harbaugh said Friday that Nabers (knee) will "be ready to play Sunday" at Washington, Pat Leonard of the New York Daily News reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Lamar Jackson: Officially ruled out for Week 5
items.text:
Jackson (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday night's game against the Falcons, Cordell Woodland reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Rhamondre Stevenson: Expects to play, Vrabel unsure
items.text:
Stevenson (knee) said Friday that he's "ready to go", while Patriots coach Mike Vrabel said the running back "is not out as of yet" for Sunday's game against Las Vegas, according to Mark Daniels of MassLive.com.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
